name: Hannah Berg
headline: Business Analyst
summary: Business analyst with 5 years in insurance and logistics. I turn messy processes into clear requirements and dashboards, and I studied machine learning during my master's.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Gather requirements for the claims-processing platform and keep a backlog of 300 Jira tickets in shape with the product owner.
Built Tableau dashboards on claims cycle time that the operations board reviews every month.
Write SQL against the claims warehouse to size process changes before they reach development.
Modelled the business case for straight-through processing in Excel, supporting a EUR 1.2M investment decision.

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst
bullets: Mapped order-to-cash processes across three warehouses and documented 40 improvement opportunities.
Built Power BI reports on late deliveries that cut weekly reporting effort by six hours.
Maintained the Excel capacity models used for peak-season staffing.
